class.name: AudioEffectSteamDirect
class.brief_description: Applies Steam Audio direct-path attenuation and filtering to a Godot audio bus.
class.description: Renders the audible consequences of values already calculated for the direct path between one source and the listener. It can combine distance attenuation, three-band air absorption, source directivity, occlusion, and material transmission in one processing stage. This class does not inspect Godot geometry and does not run Steam Audio's simulator. A game may calculate the parameters with Godot physics, another acoustic model, or Steam Audio's [code]IPLSimulator[/code], then update this resource from the main or simulation thread. Parameter values are copied to the audio processor through atomic storage. Steam Audio's [code]IPLSimulationOutputs.direct[/code] has the same conceptual fields as this resource. Reflection/reverb and pathing outputs are separate signal paths and cannot be rendered by this direct effect. Place this effect before [AudioEffectSteamSpatial] when using both.

members.member: Low-, mid-, and high-frequency gain coefficients, respectively. Each component is clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]1.0[/code]. A value of [code]Vector3(1, 1, 1)[/code] does not absorb any band.
If [code]true[/code], applies the three-band [member air_absorption] filter.
Broadband gain for source directivity, clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]1.0[/code]. This is the evaluated directivity term, not a description of the source's directivity pattern.
Frequency-independent distance gain, clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]1.0[/code]. This effect consumes a calculated gain; it does not receive or measure source distance.
Direct-path visibility factor, clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]1.0[/code]. [code]0.0[/code] is fully occluded and [code]1.0[/code] is unoccluded.
If [code]true[/code], applies [member occlusion]. No ray cast is performed by the effect itself.
Low-, mid-, and high-frequency transmission coefficients for the occluded portion of the sound. Each component is clamped to [code]0.0[/code]–[code]1.0[/code].
If [code]true[/code], applies material transmission together with occlusion. The caller is responsible for deriving coefficients from intersected geometry and acoustic materials.
Selects frequency-independent or three-band frequency-dependent transmission.

constants.constant: Applies the low-, mid-, and high-frequency coefficients in [member transmission].
